# Mastercard GFF 2026 AI Defense Lab

> Independent competition prototype for governed synthetic payment-fraud research. No real customer data, live payment access, or automatic production model promotion.

Canonical agent context: /agent-context.json
Human implementation guide: /guide.html
Repository: https://github.com/nemesis0007/fraudguard-360

## Recommended workflow

1. Discover: inspect AI-enabled attack families and create safety-bounded scenario metadata.
2. Generate: require human approval, then create reproducible fictional transactions with provenance.
3. Defend: score transactions with the locked local XGBoost artifact and graph/rule signals.
4. Prove: inspect precision, recall, F1, false positives, false negatives, and an excluded-family holdout.
5. Learn: place model misses into a human-reviewed retraining-candidate queue. Never auto-promote.

## Grounded facts

- Dataset: 210,000 synthetic payment events; 21 trained attack families plus LAUNDER_001 held out completely.
- Model: portable local XGBoost artifact, version auralis-xgb-210k-932b64e9bc, threshold 0.405.
- Test metrics: precision 0.784869, recall 0.829953, F1 0.806782, ROC AUC 0.944223.
- Holdout metrics: precision 0.763884, recall 0.856142, F1 0.807386.
- Decisions: ALLOW, STEP_UP, REVIEW, BLOCK.
- GenAI scope: offline scenario planning and defensive metadata only; human review is mandatory.
